interface.signature: def solution(full_text: str, search_text: str) -> int

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(full_text) - len(search_text) + 1) if full_text[i:i+len(search_text)] == search_text)
postconditions.description: The return value equals the total count of occurrences of search_text within full_text, including overlapping matches.
